errors.offer_unknown: That offer link doesn’t open anything. Check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.offer_used_up: That offer has been used by as many houses as it allows.
errors.offer_not_yours: That offer is for someone else. Sign in with the email it was sent to.
errors.offer_used: That offer has been used already.
errors.offer_plan: That offer doesn’t work on that plan.
errors.offer_has_pass: Your house has the House Pass already.
errors.promotion_code_taken: Another promotion has that code. Pick another.
errors.promotion_needs_people: Add the emails of the people it’s for.
errors.promotion_too_many: A promotion can name up to 500 people.
errors.promotion_ends_past: Pick an end day after today.
errors.promotion_bad_email: One of those emails isn’t an email.
errors.promotion_bad: That promotion doesn’t add up. Check what it gives and who it’s for.
errors.already_in_house: You’re already in a house. Leave it first to join another.
errors.unknown_code: That invite doesn’t open a house. Ask whoever sent it for a new one, or start your own.
errors.unknown_timezone: That time zone isn’t one we recognise.
errors.admins_only: {kind, select, family {Only the parents can do that.} other {Only the house admins can do that.}}
errors.last_admin: {kind, select, family {Make someone else a parent first. A family needs at least one.} other {Make someone else an admin first. A house needs at least one.}}
errors.photo_required: This John needs a photo with the tick.
errors.photo_path: That photo doesn’t belong to this John.
errors.under_dispute: Someone’s disputing this tick, so it can’t be undone now.
errors.own_john: You can’t vote on your own John, or on a cover of it.
errors.own_result: {kind, select, family {You can’t change your own result. Ask another parent.} other {You can’t change your own result. Ask another admin, or let the house question it.}}
errors.flagged_recently: That was just done after the last flag. It can be flagged again a little later.
errors.not_disputable: That tick can’t be disputed any more.
errors.not_swappable: Only two open Johns from the same week can be swapped.
errors.swap_due: Only Johns that aren’t due yet can be swapped, yours and theirs.
errors.cover_held: They said they’re on it. You can cover it once their time is up.
errors.cover_held_once: You’ve already said you’re on it.
errors.no_johns: Add at least one John first.
errors.week_started: Someone’s already ticked or flagged a John this week, so it can’t be re-dealt.
errors.group_empty: A group needs at least one person in it.
errors.not_housemates: Groups can only hold people who live here.
errors.unknown_group: That group doesn’t exist any more.
errors.group_name_taken: There’s already a group with that name.
errors.away_in_past: Time away can start today at the earliest.
errors.away_backwards: The last day away has to be on or after the first.
errors.away_too_long: Time away can be up to three months at once.
errors.away_overlaps: You’re already away for some of those days.
errors.away_over: That time away has already finished.
errors.moving_in_past: Your moving-out day can be today at the earliest.
errors.moving_too_far: Pick a moving-out day within the next year.
errors.no_pass_to_leave: There’s no House Pass with you to leave.
errors.cannot_undo: That can’t be undone any more.
errors.disputed: Someone’s disputing this tick. Settle the dispute first.
errors.unknown_outcome: Pick done, late, missed or let off.
errors.unknown_reset: That isn’t a reset Jonz knows.
errors.already_let_off: That month’s forfeits are already let off.
errors.nothing_to_reset: Nothing to reset: nobody has ticked anything there.
errors.not_this_week: Only this week can be re-dealt.
errors.not_on_call: That John isn’t on call, so it can’t be flagged.
errors.not_dealt: This week hasn’t been dealt yet, so nobody is on call.
errors.nobody_home: Everyone who shares that John is away today.
errors.just_done: You’ve just done that one. Undo it if that was a mistake.
errors.flag_settled: That flag has been ticked. Undo the tick instead.
errors.not_your_flag: {kind, select, family {Only whoever raised a flag, or a parent, can take it down.} other {Only whoever raised a flag, or an admin, can take it down.}}
errors.tick_it_yourself: That’s your John. Tick it off instead.
errors.too_soon_to_cover: It’s still theirs to do. You can cover it once the grace period is up.
errors.pass_needed: Changing your list with Jonz comes with the House Pass.
errors.draft_limit: That’s enough for one day. Add the draft as it is and change it on the list, or try again tomorrow.
errors.ask_pool_used: Your house has used this week’s Ask Jonz. It comes back when the house’s week starts.
errors.ask_share_used: You’ve used your half of the house’s Ask Jonz this week. It comes back when the house’s week starts.
errors.john_covered: Someone else covered this one. Dispute it if it wasn’t done.
errors.roll_call_needed: A John done together is ticked with who did it. Open it and mark it done there.
errors.not_in_crew: Whoever ticks it did it, so you’re on the list.
errors.left_off: The roll call said you weren’t there. Dispute it on the John if you were.
errors.not_your_tick: Only whoever ticked it can take it back. Dispute it if it’s wrong.
errors.same_job: You’re both on that John already.
errors.bad_prefs: Those didn’t save. Pick days of the week, and morning, afternoon or evening.
errors.plan_time: Pick a time from now until the end of this week.
errors.already_asked: You’ve already asked about that John today.
errors.swap_gone: That ask has run out, so the Johns stay as they were.
errors.owner_only: Only the owner can do that, signed in with their code.
errors.ask_limit: That’s enough questions for one day. Ask again tomorrow, or use the admin pages.
errors.notice_ends_first: A notice has to end after it starts.
errors.audit_append_only: The audit log can’t be changed.
errors.no_deletion: That account isn’t waiting to be deleted any more.
errors.no_account: There’s no Jonz account with that email.
errors.already_deleting: That account is already waiting to be deleted.
errors.report_kind: Pick a problem, an idea or a question.
errors.report_words: Say what happened, in up to 2,000 letters.
errors.report_shot: That screenshot didn’t upload. Add it again.
errors.report_limit: That’s a lot for one day. Try again tomorrow, or email support@jonz.app.
errors.report_state: A report can be marked fixed, or opened again.
errors.report_same: A report can’t be the same as itself.
errors.message_audience: Send it to a person, a house or everyone.
errors.message_wall_person: A Wall is the whole house’s, so a message to one person can’t go on it.
errors.message_no_way: Pick at least one way to send it.
errors.message_nobody: Nobody would get that: there’s nobody there to send it to.
errors.parents_only: Only a parent can OK a John.
errors.parents_add_kids: Only a parent in a family can add a child.
errors.bad_born_year: Give the year they were born. Kids are 18 or under.
errors.nothing_to_ok: That tick has already been answered.
errors.nothing_to_pay: There’s nothing left to pay for that month.
errors.not_pay_day_yet: Pay day is the 1st, once the month is over.
errors.kids_without_sign_in: A kid without a sign-in can only be in a family. Remove them first.
errors.not_a_family: The board is only for a family.
